name: lua-language-server
description: Lua Language Server (LSP) providing completion, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, and type checking via JSON-RPC over stdio

lua-language-server.description: LuaLS — Language Server Protocol implementation for Lua: diagnostics, completion, hover, references, type inference via EmmyLua/LuaCATS annotations, runs over stdio JSON-RPC
lua-language-server.usage:
lua-language-server # Start LSP server on stdio (invoked by editors, not directly)
lua-language-server --check ./src # CLI diagnostics over a directory
lua-language-server --check ./src --checklevel=Warning # Filter severity
lua-language-server --check ./src --logpath=./logs # Custom log location
lua-language-server --version # Print version
